title: the Coral Triangle Rising
author: Yara Sandoval
blurb: Ansel Montrose, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
